content: The Grand Theft Auto 6 " New Zealand trick" is a popular method players are using to play the world's most anticipated game a little early, but you need to know exactly what to do. It involves changing the time and date on your console to New Zealand's time zone, as it means as soon as the GTA 6 release time comes around over there, aka at midnight, you'll be able to play. However, there are a couple of caveats that come with it.
